measurements.name: retained
measurements.source:
constant seed = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
on run n
 put seed into values
 put values into original
 repeat for each i in 1..128
  put i into item -1 of values
 end repeat
 return item -1 of original + item -1 of values
end run

measurements.name: alias
measurements.source:
constant seed = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]

measurements.name: snapshots
measurements.source:
constant seed = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
on run n
 put seed into values
 put values into original
 repeat for each i in 1..64 collecting values into versions
  put i into item -1 of values
 end repeat
 return item -1 of item 1 of versions + item -1 of item 64 of versions
end run

measurements.name: protected
measurements.source:
constant seed = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
on run n
 put seed into values
 put values into original
 try
 repeat for each i in 1..128
  put i into item -1 of values
 end repeat
 finally
  put 0 into done
 end try
 return item -1 of original + item -1 of values
end run

measurements.name: nested
measurements.source:
constant seed = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
on run n
 put [seed] into values
 put values into original
 repeat for each i in 1..128
  put i into item -1 of item 1 of values
 end repeat
 return item -1 of item 1 of original + item -1 of item 1 of values
end run
